Question:
List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
WITH venue_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    bs.BowlerID,
    bs.MatchID,
    bs.GameNumber,
    bs.HandiCapScore,
    bs.WonGame,
    t.TourneyLocation,
    t.TourneyDate
  FROM Bowler_Scores bs
  JOIN Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
  JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
  JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
  WHERE bs.WonGame = 1 
    AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
    AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
bowler_venues AS (
  SELECT 
    BowlerID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) as venue_count
  FROM venue_wins
  GROUP BY BowlerID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT 
  b.BowlerID,
  b.BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerLastName,
  vw.MatchID,
  vw.GameNumber,
  vw.HandiCapScore,
  vw.TourneyDate,
  vw.TourneyLocation
FROM venue_wins vw
JOIN bowler_venues bv ON vw.BowlerID = bv.BowlerID
JOIN Bowlers b ON vw.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
WHERE vw.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
ORDER BY b.BowlerID, vw.TourneyLocation, vw.MatchID, vw.GameNumber

SELECT b.BowlerID, b.BowlerFirstName, b.BowlerLastName, bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, t.TourneyDate, t.TourneyLocation
FROM Bowler_Scores bs
JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
JOIN Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
WHERE bs.WonGame = 1 
  AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
  AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
  AND bs.BowlerID IN (
    SELECT bs2.BowlerID
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs2
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm2 ON bs2.MatchID = tm2.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t2 ON tm2.TourneyID = t2.TourneyID
    WHERE bs2.WonGame = 1 
      AND bs2.HandiCapScore <= 190
      AND t2.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
    GROUP BY bs2.BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TourneyLocation) = 3
  )
ORDER BY bs.BowlerID, t.TourneyLocation, bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber

WITH bowler_venues AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.BowlerID,
        t.TourneyLocation,
        tm.MatchID,
        bs.GameNumber,
        bs.HandiCapScore,
        t.TourneyDate,
        bs.WonGame
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
),
bowlers_at_all_venues AS (
    SELECT BowlerID
    FROM bowler_venues
    GROUP BY BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT 
    b.BowlerID,
    b.BowlerFirstName,
    b.BowlerLastName,
    bv.MatchID,
    bv.GameNumber,
    bv.HandiCapScore,
    bv.TourneyDate,
    bv.TourneyLocation
FROM bowlers_at_all_venues ba
JOIN bowler_venues bv ON ba.BowlerID = bv.BowlerID
JOIN Bowlers b ON ba.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
WHERE bv.WonGame = 1
ORDER BY b.BowlerID, bv.TourneyLocation, bv.MatchID, bv.GameNumber

WITH bowlers_at_thunderbird AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, bs.WonGame, t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation = 'Thunderbird Lanes'
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
bowlers_at_totem AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, bs.WonGame, t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation = 'Totem Lanes'
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
bowlers_at_bolero AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, bs.WonGame, t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation = 'Bolero Lanes'
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190

qualifying_bowlers AS (
    SELECT bt.BowlerID
    FROM bowlers_at_thunderbird bt
